sections.heading: Tax offsets
sections.text:
Check whether you will receive a tax offset and how to calculate it.

Find out how tax offsets can reduce the tax you pay.

Check if you are eligible for the seniors and pensioners tax offset (SAPTO) and if you can transfer unused offsets.

Check if you can claim a superannuation-related tax offset for you or your spouse.

Check if you can get a tax offset when you receive certain Australian Government payments or allowances.

Check if you can claim a tax offset to cover the cost of your private health insurance premium.

Check if you can claim a tax offset for maintaining an invalid or invalid carer who is 16 years old or older.

Check if you are eligible for a tax offset for living in a remote area or serving overseas as a member of a force.

Check if you can claim a tax offset for foreign tax you pay on income from another country.

Check if you are eligible for the low income tax offset (LITO).
